actions.action: Finger-check root ball moisture 3-4 inches deep before watering
Water slowly at base with 2-3 gallons per plant in early morning when dry
If wet for days, dig up one plant and replant slightly higher
Scratch loose fertilizer granules off the surface
Set up shade cloth or old sheet on stakes over plants in afternoon
Mulch over bare root ball, keeping mulch an inch from stems
Scratch a stem with fingernail to check for green tissue

reason: The main diagnosis is heat stress with the root ball drying out, which matches the confirmed underwatering, and the advice to water daily when dry, shade the plants and stop feeding mirrors the fix; the soil check is a safeguard, so nothing here is harmful.
